verdict.rationale: The docs say the agent can autonomously operate across the editor, terminal, and browser, and that it produces browser recordings as Artifacts. That implies it can drive and observe a running web app. MCP can also connect it to local developer tools. However, nothing in the evidence describes actually debugging a live application. Missing for 10: documented live-app debugging (attaching to a running process, breakpoints, console or network inspection), explicit docs tying the browser agent to debugging workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
